name: Leo
source:
He calls himself a "Great Scholar" and carries a certificate of the association, but his name is not seems to be listed among them. 
He's a man of mystery.
He spends his days quietly enjoying cups of tea and reading books in a western style mansion in a corner of the of "Water City", with his assistant Liza Fourth.

[spoiler]His true identity is Leonardo da Vinci, the sixth of the Ten Great Scholars, the "Omnipotent King".

He's the protagonist of the first part of the final chapter.[/spoiler]
